look.why: A crisp North-Atlantic sea-cyan that sets off its tuxedo plumage and bright orange-and-blue striped beak.

habitat.text: Cold North Atlantic oceans in winter, nesting on grassy sea cliffs and islands in spring and summer.

diet.text: Small marine fish—especially sand eels, herring and capelin—caught by 'flying' underwater.

facts.text: Backward-pointing spines on its tongue and palate let it hold up to 60 small fish crosswise in its beak at once!
Its famous rainbow bill is only worn in summer—in winter it sheds the outer plates and turns smaller and dull grey.

id.habitat: Samudra Atlantik Utara yang dingin saat musim dingin, dan bersarang di tebing laut berumput saat musim panas.
id.diet: Ikan laut kecil—terutama belut pasir, haring, dan kapelin—yang ditangkap dengan 'terbang' di bawah air.
facts: Duri mengarah ke belakang di lidah dan langit-langit mulutnya memungkinkannya membawa hingga 60 ikan kecil sekaligus!
Paruh pelangi terkenalnya hanya dipakai di musim panas—saat musim dingin lapisan luarnya rontok dan warnanya memudar.
